q1: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON AS S WHERE 0 = ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS AS O JOIN COMPANY AS C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE O.SALES_ID = S.SALES_ID AND C.NAME = 'RED' )
q2: SELECT NAME FROM SALESPERSON WHERE SALES_ID NOT IN (SELECT S.SALES_ID FROM SALESPERSON S LEFT JOIN ORDERS O ON S.SALES_ID = O.SALES_ID JOIN COMPANY C ON O.COM_ID = C.COM_ID WHERE C.NAME = 'RED')
